action.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT period, SUM(g.credit - g.debit) AS revenue FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND a.type = 'Revenue' AND g.period IN ('2026-04','2026-05') GROUP BY period) SELECT (SELECT revenue FROM r WHERE period='2026-04') AS april_revenue, (SELECT revenue FROM r WHERE period='2026-05') AS may_revenue, ROUND(((SELECT revenue FROM r WHERE period='2026-05') - (SELECT revenue FROM r WHERE period='2026-04')) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT revenue FROM r WHERE period='2026-04'), 0), 2) AS pct_change
